findings.title: Critical branch gate accepts raw coverage below 95% after rounding
findings.repro: Pure buildCoverageReport with all approved critical paths, each branches covered=94999,total=100000; global counts sum the unique file counts. Native verdict=PASS; snapshotSchema and verifySnapshots both ACCEPT. No V8 run or source modification.
findings.expected: Raw critical group covered/total*100 >= 95; this 94.999% report must fail.
findings.impact: Independent admission reconstructs the same rounded producer decision, so the sealed native report can satisfy the critical gate below the required raw threshold. A remote PASS was not attempted or claimed.
findings.nextActionForLead: Compare the raw critical numerator/denominator against 95 independently of display rounding, preserving manifest/schema/test bar; correction belongs to Lead after this review.

findings.title: Unit producer admission does not bind collected case identity and multiplicity before snapshot
findings.repro: validateReport(unit, report, inventory) with two collected same-name occurrences in one file accepts a one-case passing native report. It also accepts replacement of one collected title. Reports carry internally consistent native counters.
findings.expected: Admission compares complete collected file/name/occurrence membership before accepting/snapshotting.
findings.observed: ACCEPT at validateReport; REJECT by verifySnapshots with requiredTestIds. Static runScope comparison later fails the gate, after snapshotOutputs.
findings.impact: Admission parity is incomplete. This is a delayed validation gap, not a demonstrated final-scope or release bypass: later runScope and independent verifier controls remain effective.
findings.nextActionForLead: Move/share exact unit case admission before snapshot emission without weakening or changing original tests.

findings.title: Main native count remains 8400; frozen packet collector count is 8402
findings.repro: sourceFiles(source) and sourceFiles(output/runtimecopy) compared to native-main-inputs.json by path/hash/size, using only opaque document hashing.
findings.impact: All 8400 real Main inputs are copied exactly. Two additional frozen opaque documents are also included by the packet collector; native Main identity and packet identity differ. No exclusion or deletion was used to force count/hash equality.
findings.nextActionForLead: Keep both count definitions and hashes explicit in integration; investigate origin in the authorized Lead lane. This critic cannot infer document meaning or inspect Root.
